data.one_liner: Plugin for working with Lock Task and Guided Access modes on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides helper methods to check, start, stop, and stream changes to device kiosk modes such as Lock Task mode on Android and Guided Access mode on iOS.
use_when: You are building a single-purpose kiosk or point-of-sale application
You need to restrict users to a single application or a restricted set of applications
avoid_when: You do not need system-level app pinning or lock down
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platform restrictions
Provides a stream to monitor kiosk mode state changes
weaknesses: Android requires polling with a configurable interval to watch mode changes because the platform does not provide a direct subscription
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration for Lock Task / Guided Access as detailed in native documentation.
